name: Raven Rites
tagline: Plan the whole goodbye before anyone has to guess what you wanted.
positioning: Raven Rites is the end-of-life planning app for people who'd rather sort their own funeral than leave their cousins arguing over the casket.

hero.h1: Death is inevitable. Bad planning isn't.
hero.sub: Write down your wishes, name your people, and lock the money in — so nobody has to plan your funeral while sobbing into a caterer's brochure at 11pm.

features.title: The Full Wishes Doc
features.description: Casket or compost, hymns or the playlist you actually listen to. Every choice logged in one place your family can't 'misremember.'

features.title: Locked-In Funds
features.description: Ring-fence the money now so no one's floating a $9,000 funeral on a credit card in week one of grieving.

features.title: Named Executors
features.description: Assign the responsible cousin, revoke the chaotic one, and give each person exactly the access they need — no more.

features.title: Legal-Grade Export
features.description: Generate a signed, notary-ready directive that holds up next to your will instead of living in a shoebox.

features.title: Dead Man's Trigger
features.description: When you go quiet, we quietly notify the right people, unlock instructions, and skip the guesswork.

features.title: Annual Nudge
features.description: One calm reminder a year to update your plan, because your favorite song and your least-favorite in-law both change.

testimonials.quote: My mother left us a Raven Rites file instead of a mystery. We knew the songs, the budget, the burial plot. We just showed up and grieved. That's the whole point.
testimonials.name: Delia Osorio

testimonials.quote: I run a small funeral home and half my job used to be refereeing families with no plan. Clients who arrive with a Raven Rites export cut the arrangement meeting in half.
testimonials.name: Marcus Whitlow

testimonials.quote: I'm 34 and healthy and I did this in an afternoon. Morbid? Sure. But now nobody has to guess whether I wanted to be scattered off a cliff. I do. It's in there.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

pricing.blurb: Write your wishes and share them. The paperwork can wait.
The whole plan, locked, signed, and ready when it's needed.
Plans for everyone under one roof, kept in sync.

homepage.footerBlurb: Raven Rites keeps your final wishes clear, funded, and impossible to argue with. Not a law firm. Just the thing you'll be glad you did.
